# sq-68 — Descriptor.SchemaVersion is not a compile-time constant

`Descriptor.SchemaVersion` (src/squalify/Descriptor/Descriptor.cs, about line 48) is a `public const string`, so consumers compile its value in. With the schema version changing at every squalify minor (owner, 2026-10-30: lock-step), a later change of the value would be binary-breaking. Make it a static property (or a static readonly field) before 1.0.0 so a minor can change it without rebuilding consumers. **Not in this slice:** changing the value ("1.0"), the schema, any descriptor byte.
